name: Egypt
description: Egypt sits at the crossroads of Africa and the Middle East, home to one of the world's oldest civilizations. From the towering pyramids of Giza to the serene temples of Luxor and Aswan, Egypt offers an unparalleled journey through time. The Nile River, the longest in the world, has nurtured this land for millennia.

name: United Arab Emirates
description: A federation of seven emirates on the Arabian Peninsula, the UAE blends ancient desert heritage with breathtaking modern architecture. Dubai's iconic skyline, Abu Dhabi's grand mosques, and the tranquil dunes of the Empty Quarter make it one of the most dynamic destinations in the world.

name: Turkey
description: Straddling two continents, Turkey is a land of extraordinary diversity — from the Byzantine and Ottoman grandeur of Istanbul to the fairy-tale landscapes of Cappadocia and the turquoise Aegean coast. It's a destination that captivates all the senses.

name: United Kingdom
description: A kingdom steeped in history and culture, the UK offers everything from the iconic landmarks of London to the rugged Scottish Highlands, the Welsh valleys, and the historic cities of Oxford, Bath, and Edinburgh. World-class museums, theatre, and cuisine await.
